name: Ukrainian
review: Written by Claude from general teaching knowledge about Ukrainian speakers learning American English (docs/needs.md has the sources). It has not been checked by a Ukrainian speaker yet. The friend, or any Ukrainian speaker, should read it and correct it.
missing: That sound was left out. Say it slowly and clearly, then say the whole word again.

TH.title: th as in think
TH.tip: Start from the Ukrainian с (as in сам), then slide the tip of your tongue forward between your teeth. Blow air softly, with no buzz.

DH.title: th as in this
DH.tip: Start from the Ukrainian з (as in зуб), then slide the tip of your tongue forward between your teeth. Keep the buzz going.

W.title: w as in wet
W.tip: Make it a very short у (as in ум): round your lips and glide quickly into the next vowel, so wet starts like у-ет. Keep your teeth off your lip.

V.title: v as in very
V.tip: Press your top teeth on your lower lip and let the air buzz through. It is a bit stronger than the Ukrainian в, with the teeth really touching.

R.title: r as in red
R.tip: Don't roll or tap it like the Ukrainian р. Pull the tip of your tongue back without touching anything, and round your lips a little.

NG.title: ng as in sing
NG.tip: Use the н you say in банк (before к), then stop right there. Sing ends with that sound, and there is no г at the end.

AE.title: a as in cat
AE.tip: It sits between the Ukrainian е and а. Say е (as in мене), then open your mouth wider, as for а, and keep your tongue forward.

EH.title: e as in bed
EH.tip: Like the Ukrainian е in день. Keep your mouth only half open, not as wide as in cat.

IH.title: i as in sit
IH.tip: Like the Ukrainian и in шип (ship is almost шип). It is short and relaxed, with your lips loose.

IY.title: ee as in see
IY.tip: Like the Ukrainian і in ліс, but hold it a little longer, with your lips spread in a smile.

UH.title: oo as in book
UH.tip: A short, relaxed у, with your lips only a little round. Don't hold it long, like in food.

UW.title: oo as in food
UW.tip: A long у with round lips, held a little longer than you would in Ukrainian.

OW.title: oh as in go
OW.tip: Say the Ukrainian о, then slide your lips into у before you finish: о-у. English oh is not a pure vowel.

AO.title: aw as in caught
AO.tip: Like the Ukrainian о in сон, with no glide at the end. Hold your lips still. It is not oh.

AA.title: o as in hot
AA.tip: Like the Ukrainian а in мама, with your mouth wide open. It is not о.

AH1.title: u as in cut
AH1.tip: Like a short, relaxed а (as in мама), with your mouth only half open. It is shorter than the Ukrainian а.

AH0.title: the small uh
AH0.tip: In a weak syllable, English relaxes the vowel into a short uh in the middle of your mouth. Don't say a clear а or о: make it quick and lazy.

ER.title: er as in her
ER.tip: There is no Ukrainian match. Say the English r, but hold it like a vowel: tongue tip pulled back, lips a little round, no tapping.

HH.title: h as in home
HH.tip: A soft breath, like a quiet х, from the throat. Don't use the Ukrainian г, which buzzes. This sound has no buzz.

P.title: p as in pin
P.tip: At the start of a word, say it with a puff of air. Hold your hand in front of your mouth: you should feel the puff. Ukrainian п has no puff.

T.title: t as in ten
T.tip: At the start of a word, say it with a puff of air. Hold your hand in front of your mouth: you should feel the puff. Ukrainian т has no puff.

K.title: k as in key
K.tip: At the start of a word, say it with a puff of air. Hold your hand in front of your mouth: you should feel the puff. Ukrainian к has no puff.

swaps.TH>s: You said s: your tongue stayed behind your teeth. Move the tip forward until it touches the edge of your top teeth.
swaps.TH>t: You said t: your tongue stopped the air. Let it rest lightly between your teeth and keep the air flowing.
swaps.TH>d: You said d: your tongue stopped the air and buzzed. This th has no buzz, just soft air between your teeth.
swaps.TH>f: You said f: your lip touched your teeth. Keep your lips apart and put the tongue between your teeth.
swaps.DH>d: You said d: your tongue tapped behind your teeth. Let it stay between your teeth, and let the air buzz through.
swaps.DH>z: You said z: your tongue stayed behind your teeth. Move the tip forward, between your teeth.
swaps.W>v: You said v: your teeth touched your lip. Keep them apart, and round your lips like for у.
swaps.V>w: You said w: your lips were round. Put your top teeth on your lower lip and let the air buzz.
swaps.R>l: You said l: your tongue touched the roof of your mouth. For r, the tip of your tongue stays free, pulled back.
swaps.NG>n: You said n: your tongue tip touched behind your teeth. For ng, the back of your tongue lifts to the roof, like the н in банк.
swaps.IY>ɪ: You said the short i of ship. Smile, and hold it a little longer, like the Ukrainian і.
swaps.IH>i: You said the long ee of sheep. Relax your lips and make it short, like the Ukrainian и.
swaps.AE>ɛ: You said e (as in bed). Open your mouth wider, as for а.
swaps.EH>æ: You said a (as in cat). Open your mouth less, like the Ukrainian е.
swaps.UW>ʊ: You said the short oo of book. Round your lips and hold it a little longer.
swaps.UH>u: You said the long oo of food. Relax your lips and make it short.
swaps.OW>ɑ: You said it with no glide. Start with о and finish with у.
swaps.AO>oʊ: You glided at the end. Caught is a pure vowel, like the о in сон: keep your lips still.
swaps.P>b: You said b: your voice buzzed. For p there is no voice, just a puff of air.
swaps.T>d: You said d: your voice buzzed. For t there is no voice, just a puff of air.
swaps.K>g: You said g: your voice buzzed. For k there is no voice, just a puff of air.
